newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy shares end sharply easier, just off day lows.
newsitem.headline: Italy shares end sharply easier, just off day lows.

text.p: 1625 GMT - Italian stocks ended an easier session sharply lower just off day's lows on Wall Street's losses and weakness in the debt market. Traded volume seen at only a modest 500 billion lire.
"It was a day of just following other foreign markets in a market lacking impetus and a direction of its own," one trader said.
* All-share Mibtel index closed 1.15 percent down at 10,226 against a low of 10,211. The Mib30 blue chip index ended 1.26 percent off at 15,222 after a day's low of 15,193.
